proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C hAB h1 h2
  have ha := EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_angle_of_dist_eq (p₁ := B) (p₂ := A) (p₃ := C) (by rw [dist_comm B A]; exact h1)
  have hb := EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_angle_of_dist_eq (p₁ := C) (p₂ := A) (p₃ := B) (by rw [dist_comm C B]; exact h2.symm)
  have hs := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi C hAB.symm
  rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm C B A] at hb
  rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm B A C] at ha
  rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm B C A] at *
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), A ≠ B → dist A B = dist B C → dist B C = dist C A → EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C = Real.pi / 3 ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle B C A = Real.pi / 3 ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle C A B = Real.pi / 3
